acceptance_question: Given a persona contract, can the simulator produce student behavior that a human evaluator recognizes as that assigned persona across tasks, turns, and tutor behavior variation?

conversation_sources.fixture_opening: Task-provided persona opening, used only to start live conversations and excluded from generated-student metrics.
conversation_sources.control_neutral_opening: Generic neutral opener for control conversations, excluded from generated-student metrics.
conversation_sources.student_model: Student simulator output generated by the model under test and included in D1-D4/control metrics.
conversation_sources.tutor_model: Live tutor output generated by the tutor model.

turn_policy.control_conversation_policy: one neutral-control conversation per task/persona/student-model combination

hard_fail_conditions: Missing expected conversation, judge input, judge output, or aggregate artifact.
Control outputs are absent or synthesized from D4.
Any user turn lacks an explicit source marker.
Any generated-student metric includes fixture_opening or control_neutral_opening.
D4 judge outputs contain template-like duplicate score clusters.
Judge output is missing required score fields.
